The '''Boltrunia system''' was located in the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] in an intersecting portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Boltrunian/Legends|Boltrunian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Wizards" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Boltrunia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square U-11.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
